topography.project_purpose: Leveraged Farming. Structurally: 79 project-authored contract(s) across 2 chain(s); 2 ERC4626 vaults, 5 ERC20 tokens, 1 ERC1155 multi-token, 7 Chainlink feeds; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 8 functional families. Its contracts share 10 common project-authored base contract(s) (storagelayoutv1, erc1967upgrade, storagelayoutv2). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
